goal: Allow bitcoin-gui to attach to an already running node socket instead of spawning a new child process
Let users leave a node daemon running in the background and connect or disconnect the GUI on demand
reviewability: Review #10102 first: stacked on #10102, #19460, and #29409 whose changes are included in this diff
agreement: Concept approval with support for the option naming (laanwj)
Assertion failure crash when using external signers or PSBTs over IPC remains unaddressed (Sjors)
Node crash when GUI connects without -disablewallet to a wallet-disabled node confirmed but unfixed (jimhashhq)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it lets users connect the GUI to a running node on demand without restarting the daemon
It advances the process-separation project toward running GUI and node processes independently

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because changes to signal lifetime semantics in btcsignals specifically serve the IPC architecture
The utility modifications are narrow adjustments supporting multiprocess event handling
